notes.title: Release Note 0.2.0
notes.notes: [p][b]Software CEO – Demo Update v0.2.0[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]New[/b][/p][list][*][p]Completed the [b]IT management system[/b] with the addition of [b]server racks and on-premise servers[/b]. You are no longer limited to renting cloud servers, you can manage your own infrastructure.[/p][/*][*][p]Objects now [b]lose value over time[/b] and can no longer be sold for the same price they were purchased.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Updates[/b][/p][list][*][p]Rebalanced gameplay:[/p][list][*][p][b]Component creation is faster[/b].[/p][/*][*][p][b]Services generate less revenue[/b] overall.[/p][/*][*][p]Many over tweaks[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Various bug fixes and minor improvements.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Release Note 0.1.3
notes.notes: [p][b]Software CEO – Demo Update v0.1.3[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]New[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added a [b]virtual server rental system[/b]: you can now rent cloud servers to keep your online services running.[/p][list][*][p]Multiple server types are available, organized by tier.[/p][/*][*][p]Servers are purchased using IT components (no money cost), but require a [b]daily rental fee[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]If your servers are overloaded, your services will start losing users.[/p][/*][*][p]I strongly recommend starting a new game to fully experience this new system.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][b]Updates[/b][/p][list][*][p]Reduced the speed at which employee computers lose performance by [b]50%[/b].[/p][/*][*][p]Adjusted the [b]user capacity per feature[/b]: lower-tier features now bring fewer users, while higher-tier ones bring more. This change rewards investing in advanced features.[/p][/*][*][p]The [b]Escape key[/b] can now be used to close menus and exit object placement mode.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Minor fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor performance improvements.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Release Note 0.1.2
notes.notes: [p][b]Software CEO – Demo Update v0.1.2[/b][/p][p][/p][p][b]New[/b][/p][list][*][p]Added the [b]IT role[/b]: you can now recruit IT employees to create IT components required for managing your company’s IT infrastructure.[/p][/*][*][p]Introduced a [b]performance system for computers[/b]: machines degrade over time and must be maintained or repaired using IT components matching their tier.[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fixed an issue where some employee requirement items appeared as “ghost” objects that could not be purchased.[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed a bug where modifying an employee’s desk or furniture while in pause mode (without moving the desk) caused the employee to freeze and stop working when resuming the game.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor fixes.[/p][/*][*][p]Minor performance improvements.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Software CEO Demo is available!
notes.notes: [p]Hello everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]I’m really excited (and a bit proud!) to announce that the [b]free demo of [i]Software CEO[/i][/b] is now live on Steam! [/p][p][/p][p]This demo gives you access to the [b]full game experience[/b], with progression available up to [b]Tier 2 of the components system[/b]. It’s the perfect chance to start building your own software company, hire your first employees, and grow from a small startup into a rising business.[/p][p][/p][p]I can’t wait to hear your feedback — it means a lot, and it will help me shape the future of the game. This is just the beginning: I’ll keep working hard to bring in new features and more depth to the game.[/p][p][/p][p]Thank you so much for your support, and I hope you’ll enjoy playing the demo as much as I enjoyed making it![/p][p][/p][p][b]Play the free demo now and let me know what you think![/b][/p][p][/p][p]David from Deltacraft Games[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Welcome! And a quick note from the solo dev behind Software CEO
notes.notes:
[p]Hi everyone,[/p][p][/p][p]If you played my previous game, you might remember that communication and post-launch support weren’t what they should’ve been. I want to start by [b]sincerely apologizing[/b] for that. As a solo developer, I made mistakes — and I’ve learned from them.[/p][p][/p][p]With [b]Software CEO[/b], I’m starting fresh. I’m working solo again, but with clearer goals, better tools, and a stronger focus on community from day one.[/p][p][/p][p]This hub will be the place where I share progress, answer questions, and collect your feedback. Whether you’re here out of curiosity or already interested in the project — [b]thank you for being here[/b]. It means a lot.[/p][p][/p][p]Feel free to ask anything, share your thoughts, or just say hi below. 
And of course, wishlist the game if you want to support the journey[/p][p][/p][p]Let’s build this together![/p][p][/p][p]– David[/p]
